start.text: You nearly slip on a patch of slick stone. Looking down, you find a strip of corroded metal, one edge serrated by rust into something almost intentional. It smells like the sewer. Everything down here smells like the sewer.

choices.text: Pick it up. Beggars can't be choosers.

take.text: You wrap it in a strip of cloth and tuck it away. It's still dripping. You try not to think about what from.
